lines.zh: 我走在沙子一样的地上。
lines.en: I walk on ground like sand.
The crystals weigh me down.

lines.zh: 晶压在背上，我只能慢慢挪。
lines.en: The crystal weighs on me; I can only plod.
Four short legs, one step at a time.
The growth on my back is glowing.
I push along with my snout.
A line of prints in the sand.
I skirt the sharp stones.
My shadow looks faintly purple.
I list a little as I walk.
Grit falls off me.
I head toward the others of my kind.
The ground dries where I pass.
I pant as I walk.
I don't understand the wind.
I head where there's grass.

lines.zh: 我背上的东西又硬了一点。
lines.en: The thing on my back hardened.
I drag a patch of shade with me.
I stand on dry ground, panting.
The crystals slowly grow.
I can't eat much.
The wind in the sand is dry.
I make a low sound.
All four feet in the sand.
I lower my head and sniff myself.
I was born in this stretch.
The others stand beside me.

lines.zh: 我背上的紫又深了一点。
lines.en: The purple on my back deepened.
I keep still to save strength.
The sun makes my hide hot.

lines.zh: 我听见沙里有细微的响。
lines.en: I hear a faint sound in the sand.
I shake my ears and a layer of dust falls.
There's no water here.

lines.zh: 我转得很慢，晶压得我歪。
lines.en: I turn slowly, the crystal weighing me crooked.
You have no crystals on you.
You walk very lightly.

lines.zh: 我背上这块，你看见了吧。
lines.en: You see the growth on my back.
Touching me? Don't.

lines.zh: 我们四个是一起出来的。
lines.en: The four of us came out together.
Things here aren't quite right.
There's no purple in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我闻得出你不是本地的。
lines.en: I can tell you're not from here.
I only graze. That's all.
Step back. I'm hard to the touch.
A lot is buried in the sand.
I can't quite make you out.

lines.zh: 背上的晶崩了一角，掉在沙里。
lines.en: A corner of my crystal breaks into the sand.
That hit the hard part.
I backed two steps, sand flying.
I'm not much for crying out.
The purple deepened.
My four legs brace; I do not fall.
What leaks out is grey.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我身上的渣震落了。
lines.en: That blow shakes grit off my hide.

lines.zh: 背上的晶一沉，我慢下来。
lines.en: The crystal on my back sinks and I slow.
I wasn't well to begin with.

lines.zh: 你手里是能吃的东西吗？
lines.en: Is that something to eat?
The smell is faint, but I like it.
Lower it. I can't reach.
I could eat a little.
My belly is always empty.
Set it down. I'll get it.
Don't stand too close.
Can I eat this? I'm not sure.

lines.zh: 我嚼得很慢，牙缝里都是沙。
lines.en: I chew slowly, sand between my teeth.

lines.zh: 吃一口，我就回沙坡上去。
lines.en: One bite, and I go back up the sand slope.

lines.zh: 你另一只手里还攥着什么？
lines.en: What else is in your other hand?
This tastes of dust.
I take two steps toward you.
Don't raise your hand at me.
The crystals on my back are hot.
I'm not good at catching food.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你碰到的是石头。
lines.en: Bump me and you've hit stone.
I barely budge.

lines.zh: 你踩上我的蹄，碾了一下。
lines.en: You step on my hoof and grind it.
Now we're pressed together.
I'm heavier than I look.
You stepped back with grit on you.
The crystals on me are cold.
We kicked up sand.

lines.zh: 我把宽身子偏开，擦过你。
lines.en: I angle my bulk away and brush past you.
One block back, please.

lines.zh: 我们这一群都这么来的。
lines.en: That's how our herd comes about.
The sand makes it awkward.
It has a growth on its back too.

lines.zh: 走开些，这不是给你看的。
lines.en: Step away; this is not for you to watch.

lines.zh: 我们四个是一起长大的。
lines.en: The four of us grew up together.
My breathing rasps hard enough to stir the sand.
We pushed the sand aside.
There'll be little ones here.

lines.zh: 它们生下来背上就是紫的。
lines.en: They're purple on the back from birth.

lines.zh: 完事之后，我们各拱各的沙。
lines.en: Afterward we each root at our own sand.
I root up a stone.
I hold this in my mouth.
You can pick up most things in the sand.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它拱到旁边。
lines.en: I nudge it aside with my snout.
This one's a little cold.
I bite it slowly.
I sniff: iron, not food.
I looked, then set it down.
This grits against my teeth.
Did you drop something?
You've walked into our stretch.

lines.zh: 我抬起头看的方向是你。
lines.en: I lifted my head toward you.
The crystals are heating up.

lines.zh: 这里的东西都该是我的。
lines.en: Everything here should be mine.
I shift toward you.
You're too clean.
I'm not fast, but I keep going.
All four turned your way.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，露出背上的晶。
lines.en: I lower my head and bare the crystal.
Back off toward the rocks.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟着你的脚印。
lines.en: I follow your prints step by step.
You shouldn't have come near the herd.
Those prints in the sand are yours.
Slow, but I haven't stopped.

lines.zh: 石头挡住了你，可挡不住印子。
lines.en: The rock hides you; your prints do not.
The herd is closing in.
The crystals get brighter.

lines.zh: 你往左拐，蹄印也跟着拐。
lines.en: You turn left; the hoofprints turn too.

lines.zh: 这片沙上没有一块石头。
lines.en: There is not a stone to hide behind on this sand.
I hear you step on sand.
I drive the crystal on my shoulder into you.

lines.zh: 我这一顶，只算打个招呼。
lines.en: This shove of mine is only a greeting.

lines.zh: 我背上的晶碰了你一下。
lines.en: The crystals on my back brushed you.
The butt sends you stumbling back several steps.
I lower my head and push.
We churned the sand.
There's a mark on you now.
I backed off, panting.

lines.zh: 我把整个身子压过去撞。
lines.en: I throw my whole bulk into the shove.
You still haven't left.

lines.zh: 沙面裂开，我先探出鼻子。
lines.en: The sand splits; my snout comes out first.
Four of us at once.
This dry ground is ours.
I kicked up sand landing.
There's still soil on my back.
Wind blew sand onto me.

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻尖，天上全是灰。
lines.en: I lift my snout; the sky is all dust.

lines.zh: 这里只有这种地方能活。
lines.en: This is the only place we can live.

lines.zh: 四蹄落定，沙还在往下滑。
lines.en: My hooves settle; the sand still slips.
Something walked past here.
I sniffed the new scent.
The crystals flickered.
Fire cracked the crystals.
Too heavy. The landing hurt.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我身上的晶更沉。
lines.en: Soaked, the crystals got heavier.
The blast threw up all the sand.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的肩，只进了一点。
lines.en: The arrow went barely into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这光打进了我背上的晶。
lines.en: That light went into my crystals.
I can't eat, so I have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，晶体全都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and the crystals blazed.
There's no sand to stand on in the void.
